page.overview:
Who is August Bardolino?

August Bardolino is a Miraglianese master chef and cook in charge of the chicken of The Prince's Rest inn, considered by many the smartest establishment in Marienburg that stands next to Marquandt's Escorts. His last assignment was in the Royal Palace at Oisillon itself.
